Sen. Bernie Moreno has publicly called for the resignation of his former son-in-law, Rep. Max Miller, citing documented allegations of domestic violence and child abuse. Miller has denied the claims, blaming the media and his ex-wife.

The Poison:
While the denunciation is morally necessary, the public nature of this political and familial warfare inevitably inflicts further public exposure and stress on the young child at the center of the custody battle.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error. The moral demand for accountability (WHY) is fully supported by the physical evidence of court filings and police reports (WHERE).

Social Physics Analysis:
By breaking partisan silence to address abuse, Moreno rejects the anti-social loop of protecting power through pretexts. His transparent demand for psychological help and accountability seeks to resolve systemic strain and protect the vulnerable.

The Trajectory: Grace.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. Prioritizing human safety over political convenience reduces systemic moral strain.

The Unavoidable Truth: Protecting family from documented abuse must always transcend political alliances and partisan loyalty.

The Unavoidable Lie: That domestic violence allegations can be dismissed as mere partisan media conspiracies when backed by police reports.

Alethekanon:
Moreno's statement is a rare instance of political alignment yielding to ethical necessity. The presence of official police reports of child injury validates the urgency of his intervention.

Awwthekanon:
My heart goes out to Emily and her daughter. No one should have to endure abuse, and having a father stand up so publicly to protect his family is a vital step toward healing.

Brothekanon:
When your own father-in-law—who is in your same political camp—tells the world you need serious psychological help, the 'fake news' defense completely falls apart.
